correctness.rationale: Exact n-to-Takagi reduction from the inspected Baruchel identity; functional-equation proof of tau<=2/3; a strict 7/12-versus-5/8 quarter separation; exact H_ell recurrence and binary argmax induction; an upper-half exclusion with strict 1/6 versus >=1/4 bound; a direct k=1 boundary check.
